svg.aria-label: Where a factory is saved after the Factory Definition mission
svg.text: Where a factory is saved, after this mission
one definition on the Gateway; the machine only downloads
ON THE GATEWAY (the server) - the copy that runs
PART OF THE FACTORY: its definition
NEW
factory_definition_versions
One version is the whole factory. Saved as a draft;
only a person publishes; every version kept and
restorable; checked and shown before it goes live.
factory.yaml id, title, purpose, goal, boss seat,
defaults, repositories (0, 1, more)
seats/*.yaml one file per seat: role, machine,
agent and model, the brief, how it
starts (+ check), grants, rules,
secret NAMES, skills, files, repo
grants.yaml what each grant allows, its limits
rules/*.json the enforced permission rules
files/... tools and templates the seats use
checks/*.py Python that decides if a seat starts
skills/... the factory's OWN skills
Built from each publish, in one transaction
EXISTING
registry, schedules, triggers
EXISTING
briefs - kept as history; a defined factory's
brief is read from its definition
EXISTING
fleet skills - the skill store, named not copied
FILES: a doorway, not the home
export: a published version -> a folder of YAML
import: a folder -> a NEW DRAFT (never publishes)
Byte-identical on a second export of one version.
WHAT THE FACTORY PRODUCES: its records
EXISTING
activity, run results, problems, 08:00 emails
EXISTING
memory notes, goal numbers
NEW
journal entries - append-only, per seat
NEW
working documents - ledger, playbook, health
log; versioned, a stale write is refused
NEW
attachments - screenshots, in their own table
NEW
check state - what a check remembers
Records are never part of a definition version.
A start is due (time or interval), or a talk
or spawn. A start with a check runs it first.
ON THE MACHINE - downloaded when needed
1. The check - Python, NO model
NEW
<storage>/factory-checks/<factory>/<version>/
Runs checks/*.py with only its declared secrets.
Prints {count, context}; remembers in a state file.
Count 0: no agent,
recorded as nothing to do. Above 0: the seat starts
with what it found. e.g. new mail from listed people.
Work found: the Gateway stamps factory, seat,
version; the Director downloads the run kit.
2. The run kit
NEW
<storage>/factory-run/<session id>/
Outside every checkout. Deleted when the session
ends. Path given to the agent as CC_FACTORY_KIT_DIR.
kit.json what came from which version
brief.md grants.md
rules.json merged into the launch settings file,
never a checkout; it only ADDS limits
files/ records/ (journal, documents)
skills/ the factory skills this seat names,
seen by this session only
check.json what the check found
work/ start folder when no repository
EXISTING
factory-memory/<session id>/ beside it
3. A pooled worktree - only when declared
Only for a seat whose definition names a
repository: a fresh pooled slot off origin/main,
whatever the machine setting. It holds that
repository's code. No repository: the kit's work/.
Nothing of the factory is written into it.
Written back ONLY through the command line:
cc-devthrottle factory journal | doc | attach.
Editing a downloaded copy changes nothing.
NEVER SAVED ANYWHERE BUT THE MACHINE
secret values (cc-secrets on that machine)
signed-in browser profiles and mailboxes
The definition holds secret NAMES only. Publish
asks the seat's machine that each name exists;
a start with a missing name is refused, with why.
